A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Soammei clan]] named himself the first [[Grand Protector/Legends|Inta'si'rin'na]], or '''Grand Protector''' of the Rodians. As nominal leader of his [[Species/Legends|species]], the Grand Protector received the first [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. Recognizing the opportunity before him, the Grand Protector opted to join the Republic to allow his [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] a chance to prey upon [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large. However, doing so also presented a threat&mdash;to prevent his enemies from leaving the Rodian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the Grand Protector instituted the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]], a process by which Rodians were vetted for passage offworld.
